get.summary: Lists every vocabulary with its allowed values and their definitions.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

200.description: Every vocabulary, each with its values in the schema's order.

put.summary: Changes a version's status. Leaving draft runs the kind's publication rules; publishing stamps the publication time.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the version.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: A `version_kind` value, such as `dimension_version`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The version's surrogate key.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The transition applied; the body is the version's new state.

400.description: The kind or the target status is not a known value.

409.description: The lifecycle does not allow moving from the current status to the target; the detail names both.

422.description: Publication rules rejected the version and its status is unchanged; `violations` lists why.

get.summary: Lists every tenant for a SystemAdmin, otherwise only the caller's own tenant. Connection strings are never included.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

200.description: The accessible tenants, sorted by tenant ID.

get.summary: Lists every tenant in the directory, ordered by tenant ID.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The directory entries, ordered by tenant ID, with masked connection strings.

post.summary: Registers a tenant after verifying that its connection string routes to the tenant's own metadata database.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller lacks the SystemAdmin role.

201.description: The tenant was registered; the body is its entry with a masked connection string.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; a `connectionString` error gives the reason verification failed.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The directory entry with a masked connection string.

put.summary: Changes a tenant's provider, cache lifetime and, when one is given, its verified connection string.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The updated entry with a masked connection string.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; a `connectionString` error gives the reason verification failed.

put.summary: Permits or stops query routing for a tenant.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The updated entry with a masked connection string.

post.summary:
Tests a connection string for a tenant without storing it: it must open, and its `qe_database_info` must name
the tenant and have metadata schema version 4.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The test ran; `isValid` and `message` give its outcome.

400.description: The tenant ID or the connection string is missing or too long.

get.summary: Returns the caller's subject, tenant and SystemAdmin role.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

200.description: The caller's session.

get.summary: Lists the tenant's releases, newest first, with whether each is active and how many datasets it pins.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the releases.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The release summaries, newest first.

post.summary: Creates a draft release, copying the manifest of `copyFromReleaseId` when it is given.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the release.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

201.description: The release was created; the body is the new draft.

400.description: The key is malformed or taken, or the release to copy does not exist.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the release.

parameters.name: releaseId
parameters.description: The release.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The release.

delete.summary: Deletes a draft release and its manifest.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the release.

parameters.name: releaseId
parameters.description: The draft release.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

409.description: The release is not a draft.

204.description: The release and its manifest are deleted.

get.summary: Lists a release's manifest: the dataset version it pins for each dataset.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the release.

parameters.name: releaseId
parameters.description: The release.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The manifest rows, ordered by dataset.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the release.

parameters.name: releaseId
parameters.description: The draft release.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

409.description: The release is not a draft.

200.description: The stored manifest rows, ordered by dataset.

400.description: A dataset does not exist, or a dataset or dataset version appears more than once.

post.summary:
Makes a published release the one runtime queries use: sets `qe_database_info.active_release_id` and
`updated_at`, and advances the semantic revision.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the release.

parameters.name: releaseId
parameters.description: The published release.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The release is active; the body is the updated database info.

409.description: The release is not published, so nothing changed; the detail names its status.

get.summary: Reads the tenant's identity and semantic revision, its active release, its counts and its drafts in progress.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant to summarize.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The tenant overview.

get.summary: Lists the items of one picker, such as the versions of a dimension.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant whose metadata is listed.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: A `lookup_kind` value, such as `dimension-versions`.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: The owning row's ID; required for child kinds, optional for `mapping-sets`, ignored otherwise.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The picker's items, sorted by key unless the kind has a natural order (versions, levels, members).

400.description: The kind is not a `lookup_kind` value, or a child kind has no `parentId`.

get.summary: Lists the tenant's assumption sets, ordered by key.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption sets.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The assumption sets, ordered by key.

post.summary: Creates a draft assumption set without pins.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

201.description: The assumption set was created; the body is the new draft.

400.description: The key is malformed or taken, the display name is missing, or the effective time is not UTC.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

parameters.name: assumptionSetId
parameters.description: The assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The assumption set.

put.summary: Changes a draft assumption set's display name, description and effective time.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

parameters.name: assumptionSetId
parameters.description: The draft assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

409.description: The assumption set is not a draft.

200.description: The updated assumption set.

400.description: The display name is missing or too long, or the effective time is not UTC.

delete.summary: Deletes a draft assumption set and its pins.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

parameters.name: assumptionSetId
parameters.description: The draft assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

409.description: The assumption set is not a draft.

204.description: The assumption set and its pins are deleted.

get.summary: Lists an assumption set's pins: the dimension version it captures for each dimension.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

parameters.name: assumptionSetId
parameters.description: The assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The pins, ordered by dimension.

put.summary: Replaces a draft assumption set's pins.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

parameters.name: assumptionSetId
parameters.description: The draft assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

409.description: The assumption set is not a draft.

200.description: The stored pins, ordered by dimension.

400.description: A dimension does not exist or appears more than once.

post.summary:
Pins, for each given dimension, its published version effective at the set's `effective_at`
(`valid_from <= effective_at < valid_to`, a null `valid_to` being open-ended), replacing the pins of
those dimensions. A dimension without such a version is left unpinned.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the assumption set.

parameters.name: assumptionSetId
parameters.description: The draft assumption set.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

409.description: The assumption set is not a draft.

200.description: All of the set's pins after the capture, ordered by dimension.

400.description: No dimension is named, or a dimension does not exist.

tenantId.description: The tenant identity used in tenant-scoped routes.

isEnabled.description: Whether query routing is enabled for the tenant.

AccessibleTenant.description: A tenant the caller may administer. It deliberately omits the tenant's connection string.

AssumptionCaptureInput.description: A request to pin, for each dimension, the published version effective at the assumption set's `effective_at`.

dimensionVersionId.description: The version of the dimension that the set pins.

AssumptionPinInput.description: One pin of an assumption set: the exact dimension version it captures for a dimension.

AssumptionPinsInput.description: An assumption set's complete list of pins, which replaces the current one.

assumptionSetKey.description: The stable logical name, unique and fixed once created, such as `FY2026_Q3_CLOSE`.

description.description: The optional business purpose or provenance.

effectiveAt.description: The semantic time (UTC) at which capturing resolves the effective dimension versions.

AssumptionSetCreateInput.description: A request to create a draft assumption set.

assumptionSetId.description: The owning assumption set; first part of the primary key.

dimensionId.description: The canonical dimension; second part of the primary key.

dimensionVersionId.description: The exact dimension version captured; authoritative, never re-derived.

AssumptionSetDimensionRecord.description: A `qe_assumption_set_dimension` row: pins the exact immutable version of one dimension in an assumption set.

effectiveAt.description: Semantic timestamp (UTC) used to resolve which versions to capture.

contentHash.description: Optional deterministic hash of the pinned-version manifest.

AssumptionSetRecord.description: A `qe_assumption_set` row: an optional, manually created snapshot that pins exact dimension versions for reproducible reporting.

description.description: The optional business purpose or provenance.

effectiveAt.description: The semantic time (UTC) at which capturing resolves the effective dimension versions.

AssumptionSetUpdateInput.description: The editable settings of a draft assumption set; its key is fixed at creation.

semanticRevision.description: Monotonic revision the query engine uses to invalidate cached metadata.

DatabaseInfoRecord.description: The `qe_database_info` row: the singleton tenant metadata record that points runtime queries at the active release.

id.description: The row's surrogate key, which forms reference.

key.description: The row's stable key, such as a dataset key or `v2` for a version.

parentId.description: A related row's ID where the kind defines one, such as a member's parent member.

classifier.description: A vocabulary value that classifies the row, such as a field's data type.

LookupItem.description: One option of a picker: a metadata row reduced to what a select list shows.

releases.description: The number of semantic releases, whatever their status.

assumptionSets.description: The number of assumption sets, whatever their status.

activeMeasures.description: The number of measures of the dataset versions the active release pins: the measures queries can use.

OverviewCounts.description: How much semantic metadata a tenant holds.

OverviewDrafts.description: The number of rows in `draft` status per versioned kind: the work in progress.

releaseKey.description: The stable release label, unique among the tenant's releases, such as `development/baseline`.

copyFromReleaseId.description: The release whose manifest rows the new draft copies; null starts with an empty manifest.

ReleaseCreateInput.description: A request to create a draft semantic release, optionally starting from another release's manifest.

datasetVersionId.description: The version of the dataset that the release pins.

ReleaseDatasetInput.description: One manifest row: the dataset version a release pins for a dataset.

releaseId.description: The semantic release; first part of the primary key.

datasetId.description: The logical dataset; second part of the primary key.

datasetVersionId.description: The dataset version the release pins.

ReleaseDatasetRecord.description: A `qe_release_dataset` row: pins exactly one structural dataset version per logical dataset in a semantic release.

datasets.description: One row per dataset the release pins.

ReleaseManifestInput.description: A release's complete manifest, which replaces the current one.

isActive.description: Whether `qe_database_info.active_release_id` points at the release, so runtime queries use it.

datasetCount.description: The number of datasets the release's manifest pins.

ReleaseSummary.description: A semantic release as the release list shows it: the row, whether it is the active release, and the size of its manifest.

rule.description: A short snake_case code for the rule, such as `closure_mismatch`.

message.description: What is wrong, written for the person editing the version.

RuleViolation.description: One reason a publication rule rejects a version.

violations.description: The rule violations, each with a snake_case rule code and a message.

RuleViolationProblemDetails.description: A 422 problem whose `violations` list every rule that rejected the change.

contentHash.description: Optional deterministic hash of the release definition graph.

SemanticReleaseRecord.description: A `qe_semantic_release` row: the immutable manifest root for one coherent structural semantic model.

tenantId.description: The caller's tenant when the token carries exactly one non-blank tenant claim; otherwise null.

isSystemAdmin.description: Whether the caller is a SystemAdmin, who may administer every tenant.

SessionInfo.description: Who the caller is, as the API sees its bearer token.

status.description: The target status: a `publication_status` value (an `assumption_set_status` value for assumption sets).

StatusChangeInput.description: A request to move a version to another lifecycle status.

isValid.description: Whether the connection opens a metadata schema version 4 database that belongs to the tenant.

message.description: What the connection reached, or why it is rejected.

TenantConnectionCheck.description: The result of verifying a tenant connection string, which the tenant editor's "Test connection" button shows.

tenantId.description: The trusted tenant identity, unique and fixed once created; the database's `tenant_key` must equal it.

connectionString.description: The literal connection string, including the tenant database; it is verified before it is stored.

isEnabled.description: Whether query routing is permitted for the tenant.

metadataCacheSeconds.description: The suggested metadata cache lifetime, in seconds.

TenantCreateInput.description: A request to register a tenant in the tenant directory.

connectionString.description: The tenant's connection string with its password replaced by `*****`.

isEnabled.description: Whether query routing is permitted for the tenant.

metadataCacheSeconds.description: The suggested metadata cache lifetime, in seconds.

TenantDirectoryEntry.description: A `query_control.qe_tenant_directory` row as the API returns it: the connection string's password is masked.

isEnabled.description: Whether query routing is permitted for the tenant.

TenantEnabledInput.description: A request to permit or stop query routing for a tenant.

semanticRevision.description: The revision the query engine keys its metadata cache by.

oneOf.description: The release runtime queries use; null when the tenant has none.

counts.description: How much metadata the tenant holds.

TenantOverview.description: A tenant's metadata at a glance: its identity and revision, the active release, its counts and its drafts.

connectionString.description: A new connection string, which is verified before it is stored; null keeps the current one.

metadataCacheSeconds.description: The suggested metadata cache lifetime, in seconds.

TenantUpdateInput.description: An edit of a tenant directory row; the tenant ID is fixed and enabling has its own request.

tenantId.description: The tenant the connection string must route to.

TenantVerifyInput.description: A connection string to test for a tenant, without storing it.

status.description: A `publication_status` value (an `assumption_set_status` value for assumption sets).

publishedAt.description: When the version was published (UTC); null until then.

VersionState.description: The lifecycle state of one versioned object.

name.description: The vocabulary key the web client looks values up by, such as `publication_status`.

values.description: The allowed values, in the schema's order.

Vocabulary.description: A controlled vocabulary: the closed set of values a metadata column accepts.

value.description: The value exactly as stored in the metadata column.

description.description: The schema's definition of the value, condensed to one sentence.

VocabularyValue.description: One allowed value of a controlled vocabulary.

Bearer.description: A JWT from the identity provider, from dotnet user-jwts, or from POST /development/token on a Development host.
